title: finch ornaments
text: finch ornaments. I purchased an LED table top birch tree and I was looking for year round seasonal ornaments I could hang on it... these are PERFECT!  In fact, I am thrilled with them.  The colors, the size.. everything.  I purchased the finches, the autumn leaves and the flowers. They are strung with loops, ready to hang.  Honestly, they are so much better than I imagined or that the pictures show.  Reasonably priced in my opinion.  I included a pic with my fingers in it so you can see the size.  I can't wait to do my seasonal decor throughout the year with these.  I'm gonna see what else they have!  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  And I sure hope my pic and info were helpful to you!

product_metadata.title: Design Ideas Poplar Wood Ornaments and Trees (Arden Ornaments)
features: Colorfully stained laser cut poplar wood ornaments
Each ornament is tied with black thread for hanging
Packaged in a reusable acetate box
description: These rich colored leaves will change with the season. Hang them from our appropriately sized model deciduous tree, or let them drop to the ground. Scatter them on the dinner table to create an inviting harvest season atmosphere.
